MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage? (1 mark)

   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)

   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Marketing.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Marketing.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Marketing.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S? (1 mark)

   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

18. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
